name: Celebes Open 2018

venue.name: The Nipah Mall
venue.address: Jl. Urip Sumoharjo No.23c, Maccini, Kec. Makassar, Kota Makassar, Sulawesi Selatan 90144, Indonesia

information: Celebes Open 2018 is the 7th annual competition in Makassar, South Sulawesi. This competition is held by the local cubing community, Celebes Cubers Community. The registration fee is Rp 100.000 for early bird, and Rp 150.000 for payment after May 31st. For further information you may refer to "Payment" tab.
